// API 1 adaptation: sosboy-san. Existing Lanczos formula is preserved.
(()=>{'use strict';
const fragment=`#version 300 es
precision highp float;
// Fragment shaders default unqualified integers to mediump. Lanczos converts
// its tap index back to float for half-pixel sampling; keeping that index highp
// prevents mobile GPUs from losing the .5 phase around the 1024px boundary.
precision highp int;
precision highp sampler2D;
uniform sampler2D u_tex;
uniform vec2  u_srcSize;
uniform vec2  u_dstSize;
uniform vec2  u_dir;
uniform float u_scale;
in  vec2 v_uv;
layout(location=0) out vec4 outColor;

const float PI = 3.141592653589793;

float sinc(float x) {
  if (abs(x) < 1e-6) return 1.0;
  float p = PI * x;
  return sin(p) / p;
}

float lanczos3(float x) {
  x = abs(x);
  if (x >= 3.0) return 0.0;
  return sinc(x) * sinc(x / 3.0);
}

void main() {
  vec2 dstPx = v_uv * u_dstSize;
  float along = dot(dstPx, u_dir);
  vec2  perp  = dstPx - along * u_dir;

  float srcPos = along / u_scale;

  float filterScale = max(1.0, 1.0 / u_scale);
  float support = 3.0 * filterScale;

  int jStart = int(floor(srcPos - support - 0.5));
  int jEnd   = int(ceil (srcPos + support - 0.5));

  vec4  acc  = vec4(0.0);
  float wsum = 0.0;
  for (int j = jStart; j <= jEnd; ++j) {
    float w = lanczos3((srcPos - (float(j) + 0.5)) / filterScale);
    if (w == 0.0) continue;
    vec2 srcPx = perp + (float(j) + 0.5) * u_dir;
    acc  += w * texture(u_tex, srcPx / u_srcSize);
    wsum += w;
  }
  outColor = wsum > 0.0 ? acc / wsum : vec4(0.0);
}`;
const descriptor=Object.freeze({moduleApiVersion:1,executionApiVersion:1,kind:'renderer',
id:'lanczos3',name:'Lanczos3',version:'1.0.0',implementationRevision:'public-api1-a1',
translations:{"en": {"name": "Lanczos3", "description": "Lanczos3 resampling for the display size.", "readme": "Resamples images with the Lanczos3 kernel. Sharp edges may show ringing. Derived from Crisp Images; retain its MIT license and original attribution. No adjustment parameters.\n\nOriginal author of Crisp Images-derived portions: Ikkoru (previously credited as Igkor Bevzenidis). MIT.\nGPUIE adaptation, modifications, and maintenance: sosboy-san. This is not an official GPUIE release or endorsement by the original authors and does not imply their support. Please report GPUIE issues to the GPUIE repository.", "labels": {}}, "ja": {"name": "Lanczos3", "description": "表示サイズへLanczos3で拡大・縮小します。", "readme": "Lanczos3カーネルによる拡大・縮小。輪郭にリンギングが出る場合があります。Crisp Images由来のMITライセンス・原作者表記を維持します。調整項目はありません。\n\nCrisp Images由来部分の原作者：Ikkoru（旧表記：Igkor Bevzenidis）。MIT。\nGPUIE向けの移植・改修・保守：sosboy-san。原作者によるGPUIEの公式版・推奨・サポートを示すものではありません。不具合報告はGPUIEの公式リポジトリへお願いします。", "labels": {}}},author:'sosboy-san', homepage:"https://github.com/sosboy-san/Kavita-Komga-GPU-Image-Enhancer",license:'MIT',source:'https://github.com/Ikkoru/crisp-images',parameters:[],
create(host){let program=null,disposed=false;return {
prepare(){if(disposed)throw Error('Disposed');program=host.createProgram({fragment,samplers:['u_tex'],uniforms:{u_srcSize:{type:'vec2'},u_dstSize:{type:'vec2'},u_dir:{type:'vec2'},u_scale:{type:'float'}}});return {supported:true};},
execute({input,output}){if(disposed||!program)throw Error('Not prepared');const middle=host.acquireScratch({width:output.width,height:input.height});
const pass=(src,dst,dir,scale)=>host.drawPass({program,inputs:{u_tex:src},output:dst,uniforms:{u_srcSize:[src.width,src.height],u_dstSize:[dst.width,dst.height],u_dir:dir,u_scale:scale}});
try{pass(input,middle,[1,0],output.width/input.width);pass(middle,output,[0,1],output.height/input.height);return {kind:'written'};}finally{host.releaseScratch(middle);}},
dispose(){if(disposed)return;disposed=true;if(program)host.releaseProgram(program);program=null;}
};}});
(globalThis.__KKGR_MODULES__??=[]).push(descriptor);
})();
